name: Sheraton Waikiki
positioning: Sheraton Waikiki Beach Resort: a 31-story beachfront tower on Waikiki Beach with an oceanfront infinity pool and a family pool complex
best_for: Families who want pools, waterslides, childcare and cultural classes on site
Travelers who want direct beach access and ocean views in Waikiki

facts.text: The hotel is on Waikiki Beach, minutes from Leahi, the Diamond Head State Monument.
The hotel tower stands 31 stories tall.
Over 80 percent of the rooms and suites have ocean views.
Guests can reserve Luxury Cabanas, Mini Cabanas and Water Lounge Chairs at Helumoa Playground or the Edge Infinity Pool.
Poppins Day Care looks after children from three months to 12 years old.
Guests can join in feeding the koi in the pond right outside the lobby.
Lei making classes are offered Monday through Saturday.
Surf lessons, stand-up paddleboarding and outrigger canoe rides can be booked with Waikiki Beach Services.
RumFire offers indoor and outdoor dining with panoramic views of the ocean, Waikiki Beach and Diamond Head.
Guests can charge meals from restaurants and bars across the four Waikiki Collection resorts to their room.
The hotel holds LEED Gold certification.

highlights.text: The Edge Infinity Pool is the longest oceanfront infinity pool in North America.
Sheraton Waikiki is one of the few Waikiki hotels with true beachfront access, mere steps from the sand.
Helumoa Playground is a family pool complex with two freshwater pools and a 70-foot waterslide.
Floating yoga classes in the Edge Infinity Pool take place on anchored boards, with views of Diamond Head.
The Presidential Suites are on the 29th and 30th floors, each with two bedrooms, two full bathrooms and three separate lanais.

considerations.text: Abhasa Spa is at the sister resort next door, The Royal Hawaiian.
